Request:        destroy/ocsp/plainkey
Matching Route: ^destroy/(?P<path>.*)$

Permanently removes one or more versions in the KV store

## PARAMETERS

    path (string)

        Location of the secret.

    versions (slice)

        The versions to destroy. Their data will be permanently deleted.

## DESCRIPTION

Permanently removes the specified version data for the provided key and version
numbers from the key-value store.

versions.description: The versions to destroy. Their data will be permanently deleted.
